rules.defensiveDuels: compatible attacker or midfielder by lane; team quota retained
rules.combined: defensive-duel score * expectedMinutes / 90; no team quota
rules.combinedYellowHistory: combined ranking with regularized individual ordinary yellows per 90 replacing the historical all-cards rate
rules.adaptive: combined ranking truncated to rounded expected match yellows times referee factor, bounded to 1–5; five if unavailable
rules.foulsTieBreak: allocate expected team fouls by individual minutes and matchup-adjusted foul rate; use only within five points of the fifth combined score
rules.yellowPropensity: combined score adjusted by individual yellows per foul versus prior-season role, shrunk by 30 equivalent fouls and capped at +/-10%
